CHAPTER 5 · ITEM 05 / 11

Demand elasticity

Revenue test總收入判斷

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Relate price changes to total revenue or expenditure P × Q: a price increase raises revenue when demand is inelastic and lowers it when demand is elastic; the reverse applies to a price decrease, holding the demand curve fixed.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

沿固定需求線，缺乏彈性時價升令收入增；有彈性時價升令收入減。減價時反向；大幅變動跨越不同彈性區域時直接算 P×Q。

Along a fixed demand curve, a price rise raises total revenue when demand is inelastic and lowers it when demand is elastic. Reverse the direction for a price cut. For large changes crossing elasticity regions, calculate P×Q directly.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：P rises from 5 to 6, Q falls from 5 to 4.5. Revenue rises from 25 to 27; the quantity response is relatively small. 價升幅度勝過量跌。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Along an elastic demand segment, a small price cut causes TR to do what? 有彈性需求區減價？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
